title: Flamenco Dance Solea Upper Body Technique

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher emphasizes proper body engagement and core strength to prevent injury while dancing. She uses clear, descriptive language to explain the mechanics of movement and encourages students to practice technique during daily activities.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the focus on upper body technique for Soleá.
The teacher demonstrates how to stretch the back and engage the core.
The teacher explains the rib cage movement and how to lift it without lifting the shoulders.
The teacher guides the student through the rib cage movement on both sides.
The teacher explains how to combine rib cage movement with arm positioning.
The teacher leads a slow practice of the combined movements.
The teacher performs the movements to music.

metaphors: Pulling a bra strap in the front up
Pulling a bra strap in the back down
common_mistakes: Lifting the shoulders while lifting the rib cage
Bending over while opening the rib cage
safety: If your body starts to hurt, especially your lower back, stop.

steps_taught.name: Rib cage lift
steps_taught.description: Lifting the rib cage while keeping shoulders down and core engaged.

steps_taught.name: Marking
steps_taught.description: Combining rib cage movement with arm positioning and hip movement.

what_works: Clear, step-by-step breakdown of complex movements
Use of relatable metaphors to explain body mechanics
what_hinders: The fast pace of the music practice might be challenging for some

quotes.text: To prevent any injury, you really need to keep those abs pulled in.
Lifting up the rib cage without lifting up the shoulders.
Basically, you're pulling a bra strap in the front up.
I love calling all these like little goddess poses.
You need to be completely engaged in your body.
It's the mobility in the body that counts, so make it count.
